items.text: Christine Sarmiento is a public health nurse and operations manager running for mayor of El Monte. She works at the Los Angeles County Department of Public Health, and during the COVID-19 pandemic she served with the California Emergency Medical Services Authority in healthcare “red zones.” She later directed large-scale vaccination operations alongside county firefighters and lifeguards.
